claim: Make black see-through only where it connects to the outside: flood from outside edge, treat small gaps as walls, and keep enclosed black solid.

evidence.text: Mask rule G3 (owner chose, replacing B): black is see-through only via gaps of at least 3x3 from outside; explosions keep the older enclosed-only rule.
Scenery masks come from a whole-level sky flood keyed by cell content, with 1-2 px gaps as walls; per-cell runtime floods were too slow.
